Query.MSSQL: select c.TableName, g.GroupName , convert(bit, sign(max(convert(int, cr.CanSee)) + max(convert(int, cr.CanEdit)) + max(convert(int, cr.CanInsert)))) as CanSee , convert(bit, sign(max(convert(int, cr.CanEdit)))) as CanEdit , convert(bit, sign(max(convert(int, cr.CanInsert)))) as CanInsert from dialogcolumngroupright cr join dialogcolumn c on cr.uid_dialogcolumn = c.uid_dialogcolumn join dialoggroup g on cr.uid_dialoggroup=g.uid_dialoggroup group by c.tablename, cr.uid_dialoggroup, g.groupname having not exists (select 1 from dialogtablegroupright tr where tr.tablename = c.tablename and tr.uid_dialoggroup = cr.uid_dialoggroup ) order by 3,1
Query.ORACLE: select c.TableName, g.GroupName , sign(max(cr.CanSee) + max(cr.CanEdit) + max(cr.CanInsert)) as CanSee , sign(max(cr.CanEdit)) as CanEdit , sign(max(cr.CanInsert)) as CanInsert from dialogcolumngroupright cr join dialogcolumn c on cr.uid_dialogcolumn = c.uid_dialogcolumn join dialoggroup g on cr.uid_dialoggroup=g.uid_dialoggroup group by c.tablename, cr.uid_dialoggroup, g.groupname having not exists (select 1 from dialogtablegroupright tr where tr.tablename = c.tablename and tr.uid_dialoggroup = cr.uid_dialoggroup ) order by 3,1

Query.MSSQL: select g.GroupName , tr.TableName, X.CanSee as "ColumnRight CanSee", tr.CanSee as "TableRight CanSee" from dialogtableGroupright tr join (select c.tablename, cr.uid_dialoggroup , convert(bit, sign(max(convert(int, cr.CanSee)) + max(convert(int, cr.CanEdit)) + max(convert(int, cr.CanInsert)) )) as CanSee from dialogcolumngroupright cr join dialogcolumn c on cr.uid_dialogcolumn = c.uid_dialogcolumn group by c.tablename, cr.uid_dialoggroup ) as x on x.tablename = tr.tablename and x.uid_dialogGroup = tr.uid_dialogGroup and x.CanSee = 1 and tr.CanSee = 0 join dialoggroup g on tr.uid_dialoggroup=g.uid_dialoggroup order by 1, 2
Query.ORACLE: select g.GroupName , tr.TableName, X.CanSee as "ColumnRight CanSee", tr.CanSee as "TableRight CanSee" from dialogtableGroupright tr join (select c.tablename, cr.uid_dialoggroup , sign(max(cr.CanSee) + max(cr.CanEdit) + max(cr.CanInsert)) as CanSee from dialogcolumngroupright cr join dialogcolumn c on cr.uid_dialogcolumn = c.uid_dialogcolumn group by c.tablename, cr.uid_dialoggroup ) x on x.tablename = tr.tablename and x.uid_dialogGroup = tr.uid_dialogGroup and x.CanSee = 1 and tr.CanSee = 0 join dialoggroup g on tr.uid_dialoggroup=g.uid_dialoggroup order by 1, 2

Query.MSSQL: select c.TableName, c.ColumnName, isnull(sc.TABLE_NAME, 'missing in schema') as TableName_Schema, isnull(sc.COLUMN_NAME, 'missing in schema') as ColumnName_Schema from DialogColumn c left outer join information_schema.columns sc on c.TableName = sc.TABLE_NAME and c.ColumnName = sc.COLUMN_NAME where isnull(sc.TABLE_NAME, '') = ''
Query.ORACLE: select c.TableName, c.ColumnName, nvl(sc.TABLE_NAME, 'missing in schema') as TableName_Schema, nvl(sc.COLUMN_NAME, 'missing in schema') as ColumnName_Schema from DialogColumn c left outer join user_tab_columns sc on upper(c.TableName) = sc.TABLE_NAME and upper(c.ColumnName) = sc.COLUMN_NAME where sc.TABLE_NAME is null

Query.MSSQL: select c.name as JobChain, j.name as Job from Job j left outer join JobChain c on j.UID_JobChain = c.UID_jobChain where j.IgnoreErrors = 1 and ISNULL(j.UID_ErrorJob, '') <> ''
Query.ORACLE: select c.name as JobChain, j.name as Job from Job j left outer join JobChain c on j.UID_JobChain = c.UID_jobChain where j.IgnoreErrors = 1 and not j.UID_ErrorJob is null

Query.MSSQL: select distinct y.jobchainname from ( select x.JobToStart, j.Name Jobnames, x.jobchainname, x.UID_JobChain from Job j join ( select jc.uid_jobchain, jc.Name jobchainname, j.Name jobname, jrp.ValueTemplate, SUBSTRING(jrp.ValueTemplate, charindex('"', jrp.ValueTemplate) + 1, LEN(jrp.ValueTemplate) - LEN('value =') - 3) JobToStart from JobChain jc join Job j on j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain join JobRunParameter jrp on jrp.UID_Job = j.UID_Job and jrp.Name = 'DestinationJobName' join JobTask jt on jt.UID_JobTask = j.UID_JobTask join JobComponent jcmp on jcmp.UID_JobComponent = jt.UID_JobComponent and jcmp.componentClass = 'VI.JobService.JobComponents.DelayComponent' and jt.TaskName = 'ReActivateJob' ) x on x.UID_JobChain = j.UID_JobChain ) y where y.JobToStart not in ( select j.Name Jobnames from Job j join ( select jc.uid_jobchain, jc.Name jobchainname, j.Name jobname, jrp.ValueTemplate, SUBSTRING(jrp.ValueTemplate, charindex('"', jrp.ValueTemplate) + 1, LEN(jrp.ValueTemplate) - LEN('value =') - 3) JobToStart from JobChain jc join Job j on j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain join JobRunParameter jrp on jrp.UID_Job = j.UID_Job and jrp.Name = 'DestinationJobName' join JobTask jt on jt.UID_JobTask = j.UID_JobTask join JobComponent jcmp on jcmp.UID_JobComponent = jt.UID_JobComponent and jcmp.componentClass = 'VI.JobService.JobComponents.DelayComponent' and jt.TaskName = 'ReActivateJob' ) x on x.UID_JobChain = j.UID_JobChain and x.UID_JobChain = y.UID_JobChain )
Query.ORACLE: select distinct y.jobchainname from ( select x.JobToStart, j.Name Jobnames, x.jobchainname, x.UID_JobChain from Job j join ( select jc.uid_jobchain, jc.Name jobchainname, j.Name jobname, jrp.ValueTemplate, SUBSTRING(jrp.ValueTemplate, instr(jrp.ValueTemplate, '"') + 1, LEN(jrp.ValueTemplate) - LEN('value =') - 3) JobToStart from JobChain jc join Job j on j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain join JobRunParameter jrp on jrp.UID_Job = j.UID_Job and jrp.Name = 'DestinationJobName' join JobTask jt on jt.UID_JobTask = j.UID_JobTask join JobComponent jcmp on jcmp.UID_JobComponent = jt.UID_JobComponent and jcmp.componentClass = 'VI.JobService.JobComponents.DelayComponent' and jt.TaskName = 'ReActivateJob' ) x on x.UID_JobChain = j.UID_JobChain ) y where y.JobToStart not in ( select j.Name Jobnames from Job j join ( select jc.uid_jobchain, jc.Name jobchainname, j.Name jobname, jrp.ValueTemplate, SUBSTRING(jrp.ValueTemplate, instr(jrp.ValueTemplate, '"') + 1, LEN(jrp.ValueTemplate) - LEN('value =') - 3) JobToStart from JobChain jc join Job j on j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain join JobRunParameter jrp on jrp.UID_Job = j.UID_Job and jrp.Name = 'DestinationJobName' join JobTask jt on jt.UID_JobTask = j.UID_JobTask join JobComponent jcmp on jcmp.UID_JobComponent = jt.UID_JobComponent and jcmp.componentClass = 'VI.JobService.JobComponents.DelayComponent' and jt.TaskName = 'ReActivateJob' ) x on x.UID_JobChain = j.UID_JobChain where x.UID_JobChain = y.UID_JobChain )
